import urllib.request,urllib.error,json
root="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/"
for item,expected in [("campaigns_api.php",401),("ops.php",403),("calls_feed.php",401),("calls.php",403),("call_event.php",401),("contacts_file_api.php",401)]:
 request=urllib.request.Request(root+item,headers={"Cache-Control":"no-cache","User-Agent":"OnTrack-Mobile-Auth-Check"})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=7) as r:status=r.status
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status=e.code
 print(json.dumps({"endpoint":item,"status":status,"expected":expected}))
 assert status==expected,"Unexpected access-control response "+item
